title: Friends Remover - A Frame With A Name 🖼️
excerpt: We finally introduced Profile Frames! Your friends' Roblox Profile Frames can now be shown directly in Compact Viewer, along with over 20 bug fixes, performance improvements, and stability updates.
body:
We finally introduced Profile Frames! 🖼️

If your friend has a Roblox Profile Frame on Roblox, Friends Remover can now display that frame directly in Compact Viewer. This brings another part of your friends' Roblox profiles directly into Friends Remover.

Profile Frames are enabled by default and are designed to fit naturally into Compact Viewer while keeping the viewer compact and easy to use.

We've also made major improvements across Friends Remover, eliminating over 20 issues that could cause bugs, lag, unexpected behavior, or other problems.

These fixes improve the overall stability and performance of Friends Remover, making the extension smoother and more reliable during everyday use.

We've also continued improving how Friends Remover handles friend data, Compact Viewer, background systems, loading, and other parts of the extension.

This update may look simple at first, but it includes a large number of behind-the-scenes improvements designed to make Friends Remover work better.

And this is only the beginning. 🚀
